title: ABC Fun Song
yt_description:
Learn letters A, B, and C with Pip. Discover words that start with these letters. A fun and catchy way to introduce the alphabet.

🎵 ABC Fun Song

Hello
I'm Pip
Let's learn

A is for Apple
B is for Ball
C is for Cat

A, B, C
Fun to learn
With me

A is for Ant
B is for Book
C is for Car

A, B, C
Fun to learn
With me
Bye for now
